about.title: Who is on the other side of the terminal.
about.p1: I've been coding since 2019, growing from intern to mid-level developer on SaaS products. Today I'm a Mid-level Back-End Developer at Nexaas, working with Ruby on Rails.
about.p2: My toolkit spans Python, JavaScript, Node.js, React, SQL and NoSQL (MongoDB) databases and Selenium automation. I hold a degree in Big Data for Agribusiness from Fatec Shunji Nishimura and was a partner at a startup accelerator — so I think in product, not just code.
